Mod.Name: Mouse Keybinds / 鼠标键位支持
Mod.Author: YDXF
Mod.Description: 让游戏原生改键界面支持录入鼠标侧键（侧键1~4），键名跟随游戏语言显示；修复拖拽时滚轮偶尔无法旋转物品的问题。 Adds mouse side button capture (up to 4 side buttons) to the vanilla key rebinding UI with localized key names, and fixes the intermittent scroll-to-rotate failure while dragging.
